label: v1-a
what: first correct version: 2 io_uring loops, 1 PG thread 6r+8w, #22 batching 64:6 depth 1, 2x4 bcrypt

label: e1-tags-a
what: tags: one statement answers every queued GET /api/tags (#48 broadcast); env TAGS_BROADCAST

label: e1-on-b
what: #7 shared list form (MATERIALIZED CTEs, distinct articles enriched once) when <= half the pages are distinct; env LIST_SHARED
why: generic plan: LIMIT $n estimated at 10% of articles, so the batch's pages hash-join articles and users with seq scans (replay: 34 ms per request). Fixed later by a constant LIMIT 100 bound.

label: e3-packed-a
what: #82 packed lists (all list kinds + feed) for every batch; env LIST_PACKED/FEED_PACKED
status: discard as always-on; kept with a batch-size threshold (e5)
why: batches average 2.2 requests at this load (MC_STATS: list 2.3, feed 2.0, tag 1.5); replay: packed loses below batch 4 (list) or 8-16 (tag, feed) and wins above

label: e5-base-w3-a
what: batch clock: a kind's batch waits until its oldest request has waited 3 ms (or 64 are queued); env BATCH_WAIT_US=3000

label: e5-pm-w3-a/b
what: packed lists only from a batch size (LIST_PACKED_MIN 4 for the global list, PACKED_MIN 8 for the rest), with the 3 ms clock

label: e5-slug-w3-a/b
what: #82 shared article/comments when >= half of a batch repeats a slug; env SLUG_SHARED

label: e7-cand-a
what: candidate defaults: tags broadcast, packed lists above a batch size, 3 ms batch clock; shared lists and shared slugs off
stats: 10.2k statements per 5 s, 7.3 requests each (tags 11.3, article 11.4, comments 13.7, list 7.7, feed 5.5, tag 3.2, author 3.4)
checks: overload PASS; conformance 197/197 conduit_dev and conduit_seed
